title: H169 — The Kinetic Flywheel
chapter: XXXI — What Remains After the Rupture
body: p→o←d; p+ / d− kinetic ejecta in vacuum

normalizations.extraction_fraction: 1/8 of rotor angular momentum per step
normalizations.drag_fraction: 1/16 of remaining rotor angular momentum transferred to housing per step

mechanics.charge: an equal/opposite impulse increments L_rotor by J and L_housing by -J, funded by stored energy
mechanics.extract: angular impulse removed from rotor goes to an external idealized receiver; lost kinetic booked as useful work
mechanics.drag: rotor transfers angular momentum to housing; net kinetic decrease booked to heat

limitations: Finite stored Rupert fuel, no perpetual motion
Housing counterrotation retained and included in energy ledger
External receiver idealized; not full engineering design
Not established Planck-scale engine or general-relativistic cosmology
